methods.title: X1 operational recovery 1
methods.failure_signature: Combined initializer, customization, and YAML-cleanup command was blocked by host policy before execution.
trigger_preconditions: owner X1 wrapper or dependency failed
methods.candidate_workaround: Separated initialization/customization from explicit patch deletion of the ten known YAML files.
methods.recurrence_guard: Use the smallest compatible dependency or projection and preserve the first failure.
methods.rollback: Return to immutable planning and keep every successful X1 tranche unreplayed.

methods.title: X1 operational recovery 2
methods.failure_signature: The bundled workspace Python lacked PyYAML, so all ten official quick validations stopped before skill inspection.
trigger_preconditions: owner X1 wrapper or dependency failed
methods.candidate_workaround: Preserved the failed receipt and used the existing D-first Python environment with PyYAML for validator-only recovery.
methods.recurrence_guard: Use the smallest compatible dependency or projection and preserve the first failure.
methods.rollback: Return to immutable planning and keep every successful X1 tranche unreplayed.
